property_summary: transfer always returns true when it does not revert
The transfer function returns true when it does not revert.

After any call to transfer, the length of the _tos array must be greater than zero to guarantee that at least one transferFrom call is attempted (the reference reverts due to out-of-bounds access when _tos is empty, while the mutant does not revert).
For any call to transfer, if _tos is an empty array then the transaction must revert (the reference requires _tos.length > 0, the mutant with >= 0 does not revert).
After any call to transfer with an empty _tos array, the function must revert; the reference reverts, the mutant does not.
After calling transfer with an empty _tos array, the function must revert (the reference requires _tos.length > 0, the mutant with >= 0 does not revert).
When _tos is empty, calling transfer must revert; the reference reverts, the mutant does not.
